title: What is the Strait of Hormuz, could it factor into Israel-Iran conflict?
description: Iranian lawmaker says Tehran considering closing waterway, described as 'world's most important oil transit chokepoint'.
content:
Iran is considering closing the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian news agency IRINN has reported, citing key conservative lawmaker Esmail Kosari, as the conflict with Israel intensifies.
